sermon.title: The Sign of Sickness vs Sin — May 23, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: After a reading on Mary seeking Jesus at the tomb, Pastor David G. Kincer asks whether sickness comes from sin. Jesus said the man born blind suffered neither for his sin nor his parents’, but to reveal God’s works. Islanders assumed Paul was guilty when bitten. Sin can bring harm, but Jesus heals rather than accuses.

chunks.text:
Even the barbarians thought this now. In John 9 we’re dealing with people that believed in God. But here Paul is shipwrecked on an island where they’re barbarians they never heard of the gospel they never heard of Jesus they never heard of the God the creator they are heathen. And he is healing their sick. Okay. And these barbarians. They build a fire and Paul went to get some wood to put on the fire and as he’s about ready to put it on a snake a viper bites him and it’s clinging to him and not letting him go just pumping that venom in and everything and just pumping it in. And these barbarians.

Because they think the same way as God’s people do that bad things happen because you did something bad. They said amongst themselves no doubt this man is a murderer. And justice has caught up with him and not allowing him to live yeah he got bit because he’s bad. And he’s healing they’re sick. See this mentality is strong and it’s been strong. Since the the world began and it’s strong today. Bad things happen because you were bad you did something wrong. Then Paul shook that snake off into the fire.

An hour or so goes by and they’re waiting. And he isn’t puffing up he isn’t getting delirious he isn’t in agony he’s just. Being Paul. Then they changed their thinking. The scriptures say they changed their mind. Not to believe in Paul’s God. That Paul’s been telling them about and healing the sick not the God that healed their sick. Now they’re saying that Paul’s a God. And that’s just like the church world in Christ time and it’s just like the church world in our day if God uses anybody we elevate them and make them a hero and worship with God then we expect them to meet every need we have and we get distracted from Jesus Christ the real healer the real deliverer.

And are looking for men and women to solve our financial problems our emotional problems our mental problems our sin problems we are looking unto people. Just like they did with Paul. And Jesus is clearing all this up. You know it says in the book of mark by the way this is a fulfillment of the book of mark where he says you shall take up serpents and if you dread drink any deadly thing it shall not harm you he isn’t saying that you got to pick up a snake to prove your faith like some people do you shouldn’t be doing anything to prove your faith. If you’ve got faith God put it there you don’t have to prove anything because you got it proves that God gave it to you can I hear an amen you don’t have to do I don’t have to walk on water I don’t have to do anything to prove I’m I’ve got faith in Christ that’s called faith in your faith and that doesn’t save anybody.

And so Paul and so the scriptures show us the fulfillment of that by Paul accidentally being bitten by a snake and no harm came to him and and God favors his people and I’ll just give you a couple illustrations. scriptures.text_nkjv: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat, and fastened on his hand. So when the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped the sea, yet justice does not allow to live.” But he shook off the creature into the fire and suffered no harm. However, they were expecting that he would swell up or suddenly fall down dead. But after they had looked for a long time and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

chunks.text:

faqs.question: What did Jesus say to the crippled man?
